issues.description: Missing pipefail in shell safety mode: 'set -eu' should be 'set -euo pipefail' per code style rule 7. Without pipefail, pipeline failures may go undetected.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'set -eu' to 'set -euo pipefail' to ensure all pipeline command failures are caught.

issues.description: Uses '[test]' output markers instead of the standard '[step]'/'[ok]'/'[fail]' format specified in code style rule 9. Markers appear on lines 19, 25, 30, 35.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace '[test]' with '[step]' for step markers, '[ok]' for success (8-space indent), and '[fail]' for failure (8-space indent).

issues.description: Uses 'software:' field name instead of 'name:' as specified in code style rule 14 for manifest.yaml convention.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'software: lv' to 'name: lv' to match the manifest.yaml naming convention.

issues.description: Empty url attribute 'url = ""' — the recipe repository URL should be filled in per code style rule 5 which prohibits template placeholders in merged code. While the exact pattern 'url = "" # CI fills this' is not present (no comment), the empty URL field is still an unfilled placeholder.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set url to the recipe's repository URL (e.g., the OHOS build repo URL), or remove the attribute if not applicable.

issues.description: Machine-specific paths in patch_generation metadata: source_orig_dir '/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/lv-4.51-10.orig' and source_work_dir '/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/lv-4.51-10.work' are local development paths that are not portable. These are metadata only and do not affect the build process.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider removing the patch_generation section or replacing machine-specific paths with generic descriptions (e.g., 'build-temp/orig' and 'build-temp/work').

issues.description: Missing shebang line '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and file-header docstring per code style rule 1. The file starts directly with 'import os'. Note: this rule may be less strict for test_package conanfile.py which is not meant to be run directly.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' shebang at the top of the file. The class docstring is already present, which is good.

issues.description: lgrep -V symlink check (lines 30-33) only warns on failure ('⚠️ lgrep -V failed') but does not exit with error. Since the symlink functionality is the core purpose of the patch (0001-src-Makefile.in.patch), a broken symlink should fail the test.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'exit 1' in the lgrep -V failure block to ensure symlink integrity is verified, or at minimum add a non-zero exit at the end if any warnings occurred.

issues.description: requirements() method contains only 'pass' (line 31), which is unnecessary when there are no Conan dependencies. ncurses/tinfo are correctly declared as system_libs in package_info().
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the requirements() method entirely if no Conan dependencies are needed. Conan will default to no requirements.

issues.description: Recipe manually runs './configure' with hardcoded LIBS/LDFLAGS/LIBRARY_PATH flags in self.run() instead of using Conan's AutoToolsToolchain. While this is not a direct R33 violation (no os.environ compiler assignments), it bypasses Conan's toolchain system. The manual approach may be justified for this autotools project with OHOS-specific library path adaptations.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using AutoToolsToolchain(self) for better Conan 2.x integration and cross-compilation support, though the current manual approach is functional for the OHOS target.

summary: Audit of lv 4.51-10 (feat/lv-4.51-10 branch): 9 files audited against all code_style (25 rules) and review_memory (30 rules). NO P0 (deception) issues: test_package/test.sh invokes the real lv binary (lv -V, lv -h, lgrep -V) — not an empty shell test (R34 pass); sha256 'c93515...aba1' is a valid 64-char hex string, not all-zeros/f/short (R4 pass); status 'built' is valid per audit instructions — it means conan-verify passed, not yet uploaded to CI, and is NOT forged (review_memory rule 3 pass); no pre-compiled .so/.a/.o binaries in PR (R19 pass). NO P1 (correctness) issues: no os.environ compiler assignments (R33 pass — '/data/service/hnp' is the standard OHOS HNP root path, not a machine-specific path, similar to '/usr' on Linux); no 'if os == Linux' checks that miss OHOS (R32 pass — recipe targets OHOS directly); source URL 'https://salsa.debian.org/debian/lv/...' is the official Debian packaging repository (R39 pass); no manual packaging bypass (R19 pass); commands.json correctly declared at software level with type='tool' for the application package (R38 pass); Conan 2.x API used correctly (rule 16 pass); patch modifies Makefile.in via patches/ not direct edit (R6 pass). 4 P2 (non-blocking style) issues found: (1) test.sh 'set -eu' missing '-o pipefail' (code_style rule 7), (2) test.sh uses '[test]' markers instead of '[step]'/'[ok]'/'[fail]' (code_style rule 9), (3) manifest.yaml uses 'software:' field instead of 'name:' (code_style rule 14), (4) conanfile.py has empty 'url = ""' (code_style rule 5). 5 P3 (non-blocking suggestions): machine-specific paths in manifest patch_generation metadata, missing shebang in test_package conanfile.py, soft lgrep symlink check, unnecessary requirements() pass method, could use AutoToolsToolchain. VERDICT: PASS — no P0/P1 blocking issues found. All P2/P3 issues are non-blocking.
